							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped

	select 	*
	from 	cmb

			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only

			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select

			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'

/* cppi::b34f05e1bce62729bc4acb1d4e49ae1df7220e2e247a3b2930e5537584ecb011 */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-14')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-14')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_infra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Infrastructure'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_infra_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",

/* cppi::214c1d5a09b5cf1e1957719763123283943516a8fc55e32f4d98f3c5052adcf7 */

SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage

			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select

				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01

	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)
select * from lt_final_agg) AS "finsights_holdings_lookthrough"

				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name

		from

	left join

					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )

			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'

              model_portfolio,
              model_portfolio_name
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
       WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
         AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
         AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
         AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
         AND (
                     InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                 AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                 AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                 AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                 AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                 AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                  OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328','MPR1000200','MPAR100041')
              )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2025-06-05')
    )

SELECT
    holding.business_date                                                            AS "Business Date",
    sec.bloomberg_unique_id                                                          AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    TRIM(REPLACE(sec.bloomberg_cd, sec.sec_typ_lvl1_nm, ''))                         AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    mp.model_portfolio_name                                                          AS "Model Portfolio Name",
    mp.model_portfolio_id                                                            AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    mp.programs_name                                                                 AS "Programs Name",
    mp.canadian_foreign_emerging_general_split_name                                  AS "Canada/Foreign/Emerging Name",
    sec.sec_nm                                                                       AS "Security Name - Current",
    currency1.currency_name                                                          AS "Quoted Currency Name",
    country.country_name                                                             AS "Country of Exposure Name - Current",
    currency2.currency_name                                                          AS "Currency of Exposure Name - Current",
    holding.balance_nominal_number                                                   AS "Balance Nominal/Number",
    holding.balance_book_value_quotation_currency                                    AS "Balance Book Value QC",
    holding.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency                                    AS "Balance Cost Value QC",
    holding.clean_price                                                              AS "Clean Price QC",
    holding.clean_value_quotation_currency                                           AS "Clean Value QC",
    holding.dirty_price                                                              AS "Dirty Price QC",
    holding.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency                                     AS "Dirty Value Total QC",
    holding.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency + holding.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency + holding.next_dividend_quotation_currency + holding.next_coupon_quotation_currency + holding.accrued_interest_quotation_currency AS "Total Accrued Income QC",
    holding.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency                                     AS "Total Market Value QC",
    holding.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency                         AS "Fx Rate QC/PC",
    holding.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency                                    AS "Balance Book Value PC",
    holding.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency                                    AS "Balance Cost Value PC",
    holding.clean_price * holding.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency   AS "Clean Price PC",
    holding.clean_value_portfolio_currency                                           AS "Clean Value PC",
    holding.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency                                     AS "Dirty Value Total PC",
    holding.long_settlement_correction_value_portfolio_currency + holding.balance_expected_restitution_portfolio_currency + holding.next_dividend_portfolio_currency + holding.next_coupon_portfolio_currency + holding.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency AS "Total Accrued Income PC",
    holding.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency                                     AS "Total Market Value PC"
FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main holding
INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp invstr
        ON holding.model_portfolio_id = invstr.model_portfolio
       AND holding.business_date = invstr.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.business_date = mp.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications sec_ent
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec_ent.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec_ent.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes currency1
       ON holding.quotation_currency_code = currency1.currency_code
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = currency1.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes currency2
       ON sec_ent.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code = currency2.currency_code
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = currency2.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes country
       ON sec_ent.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = country.country_code
      AND country.business_date = CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)
WHERE CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2025-06-05')
  AND holding.cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL
  AND holding.balance_nominal_number != 0
  AND holding.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
ORDER BY holding.business_date DESC,
         sec.bloomberg_unique_id

/* cppi::88ed5ee43a3b3ff96e18e669d5845b4606999717a6e4fff3a0711c89e0754c17 */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-06-13')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-06-13')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328','MPR1000200','MPAR100041')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl

WITH
    listed_ra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name,
            InvestmentStructureLevel5
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                InvestmentStructureLevel3 IN ('Infrastructure','Real Estate','Sustainable Energy Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure','Listed Real Estate','Power and Renewables Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TAX EXP%' THEN 'Dividend Taxes'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,
            fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency-fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS total_amount_qc
            FROM latest_trans trans
            INNER JOIN latest_finance_trans fin
                ON trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
            INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp mp
                ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND trans.trade_date = mp.business_date
            LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
               ON CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
              AND trans.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
            WHERE trans.rn = 1
            AND fin.rn = 1     
    ),
    aggregated_trans AS (
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_pc,

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 19
		AND hour between 18 and 19
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-19 18:20:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

-- Query # 7 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,
        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,
        i.sedol,
        i.isin,
        i.ticker,
        COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) equity_exchange_code,
        c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        COALESCE( e.country_code, w.country_code ) country_code,
        c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        COALESCE( e.currency_code, w.currency_code ) currency_code,
        COALESCE( e.underlying_instrument_currency_code , w.underlying_instrument_currency_code ) underlying_instrument_currency_code,
        -- Capitalize first letter followed by lower case letters to follow HERBI's instrument type letter casing convention
        COALESCE( e.type, w.type ) instrument_type,

-- Query # 7 of 26 to lookup security by ticker/exchange.
    WITH latest_business_date AS (
        SELECT MAX( business_date ) business_date
        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i
        WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_equity e WHERE i.business_date = e.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )
            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications c WHERE i.business_date = c.business_date )
            )
    SELECT
        -- Some security identifiers are not associated with any sector information.
        -- If two securites have the same sedol, the security with lower Bloomberg security ID 
        -- (and lower cppib security id) is often associated with more populated fields
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.sedol ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_sedol,
        ROW_NUMBER() 
            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code ) 
            ORDER BY c.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, i.bloomberg_security_id ) ranking_by_ticker_and_exchange,
        i.cppib_sec_id,
        i.bloomberg_security_id,

        FROM asset.asset_security_identifiers i

            AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset.asset_warrants w WHERE i.business_date = w.business_date )

            OVER ( PARTITION BY i.ticker, COALESCE( e.equity_exchange_code, w.equity_exchange_code )

        i.cppib_sec_id,

        i.sec_typ_lvl1_nm,
        i.sec_typ_lvl2_nm,

SELECT "business_date", "dataset_id", "metric_group_l1", "metric_group_l2", "metric", "metric_friendly_name", "level", "investment_structure_l2", "attribution_node", "currency", "period", "value", "last_update", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with base as (
	select 
		  case
	  		when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and "level" = 0 then 'IPN_TF'
	  		else dataset_id
		  end dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, case
			when dataset_id like '%_TF' or "dataset_id" in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) then 'Total Fund'	
			when dataset_id like '%_C' then 'Core'
			when dataset_id like '%_S' then 'Supplementary'
		  end node_name
		, case
			when metric like '%rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%lc' then 'Local'
			else 'FX'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				  'MRP_TF'
				, 'RP_TF'
				, 'ATP_TF'
				, 'RISK_APP_TF'
				, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
				, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
				/* CORE POOL */
				, 'MRP_C'
				, 'RP_C'
				, 'ATP_C'
				, 'RISK_APP_C'
				, 'DIV_LVG_C'
				, 'INV_SELECT_C'
				/* SUPP POOL */
				, 'MRP_S'
				, 'RP_S'
				, 'ATP_S'
				, 'RISK_APP_S'
				, 'DIV_LVG_S'
				, 'INV_SELECT_S'
			)
			and "level" = 1
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
		union all
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level"
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local and FX values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_lc end time_weighted_return_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx end time_weighted_return_fx
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_rc end time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_lc end time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_qtd end time_weighted_return_fx_qtd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

	cross join unnest (

			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */

			  contribution_fytd_lc

			, contribution_5y_roll_lc

	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value

	inner join (

			, "level"
			, currency

), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case

						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'

				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

	cross join unnest (

		/* VALUE */

			, contribution_5y_roll_lc

	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value

), cmb as (
	select

		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case

						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select

		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name

		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value

), cmb as (

						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select

				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'

					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'

				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)

			  end metric_group_l1
			, case

						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end

					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case

							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end

					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)'

					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value

), cmb as (

		, metric_group_l1
		, case

						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name

				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date

				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end

					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (

							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/

							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end

					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll

), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (

			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */

			  contribution_fytd_lc

			, contribution_5y_roll_lc

	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value

	inner join (

		select

			, currency

		from

			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
